business_notes.value: Family-owned and locally operated, serving Alameda and Contra Costa counties since 2000, with trained journeyman plumbers; Diamond Certified for 14 consecutive years and voted best in Pleasanton.
business_notes.source: We are family-owned and locally operated. We have held Diamond Certification for 14 consecutive years and have been voted best in Pleasanton.

business_notes.value: Offers a 2-year labor warranty, fair/flat-rate pricing quoted before work starts, free estimates on most services (complex projects quoted by next business day), bilingual English/Spanish team, and same-day appointments when possible (never guaranteed).
business_notes.source: We stand behind our work with a comprehensive 2-year labor warranty, giving you peace of mind long after the job is completed.
business_notes.document: Plumbing Services | Savior Plumbing Inc. | Pleasanton, CA

business_notes.value: Does not do: septic tanks/systems, well pumps, appliance repair (supply line and drain only, not the machine), HVAC/furnace/AC, fire sprinkler systems, drywall repair (they open the wall but do not close it), and pool plumbing.
business_notes.source: septic tanks / septic systems. we do sewer not septic. refer out.

business_notes.value: Will not book jobs in Tracy, Manteca or Stockton (San Joaquin County), anything past Antioch/Oakley going east, or San Francisco/Marin/anything over a bridge; borderline addresses are checked with dispatch.
business_notes.source: tracy, manteca, stockton -- thats san joaquin, different county, we dont go

business_notes.value: Commercial work is not priced from the flat rate book — all commercial jobs are custom-quoted by Danny.
business_notes.source: Commercial pricing is not in this book. All commercial work is custom-quoted by Danny.
